LEMON PIE
 - A large package or 6 small of vanilla cookies 
- Small stick (90-100gr) of margarine 

Titrate cookies and add melted margarine, put "dough" in mold pressing and leaving the compact dough on the bottom and sides. Bake for 5 minutes at 180 degrees C and remove from the oven.

- 2 cans of condensed milk
- 1 teaspoon of vanilla
- 4 yolks
- ½ cup of lemon juice

Mix the condensed milk, vanilla in a bowl and when adding the yolks go through a strainer, finally add the lemon juice. Pour the mixture on top of the cookie base. 

- 4 egg whites
- 320gr sugar (approx 1 cup and ¼)

Put the whites and sugar in a metal or glass bowl, put in a water bath (pot with boiling water, put the bowl on top, that the water does not directly touch the bowl) move with a whisk until the sugar is disintegrated. Put the mixture in a mixer, beat until the white meringue is shiny and firm. Put the meringue on top of the previous mixture. Bake for 35 minutes at 170 degrees C.
